title: 小编辑，大模型：维基百科编辑如何塑造LLM价值观
summary: 研究表明，一个名为“亲动物维基百科人”（PAW）的小型志愿者团体通过编辑维基百科文章，能够显著影响大型语言模型（LLM）在动物福利话题上的行为。通过梯度归因等方法，发现PAW编辑的内容在模型对动物福利查询的响应中占据主导地位，表明维基百科编辑可有效塑造LLM价值观。
summary_en: Research shows that a small group of volunteers, the Pro-Animal Wikipedians (PAW), can significantly influence how large language models (LLMs) discuss animal welfare by editing Wikipedia articles. Using gradient-based data attribution, PAW edits were found to dominate model responses on animal welfare queries, demonstrating that Wikipedia editing can effectively shape LLM values.
